title: Cell Omics Explorer metabolome chemical-structure teaching library
scope_note: Representative structure families, not an exhaustive metabolome. The viewer schema is designed so arbitrary future compounds can be loaded from a database/data lake.
scientific_boundaries: 2D structures are generated from explicit SMILES connectivity.
3D views are RDKit ETKDGv3/UFF teaching conformers, not experimentally solved coordinates.
4D mode steps through conformer ensembles; it is not a molecular-dynamics trajectory unless real trajectory frames are supplied later.
Adduct m/z values are neutral-mass teaching calculations and do not model every ionization state or in-source chemistry.
The isotope envelope is an approximate 13C-only teaching envelope; production isotope prediction should use a full isotope model.
Glycan composition does not uniquely define linkage, branching, anomer or stereochemistry; explicit glycan structures need linkage-resolved records.

supported_representation_layers.label: 1D identity
supported_representation_layers.detail: Name, class, formula, exact mass, SMILES, stereochemistry and physicochemical descriptors.

supported_representation_layers.label: 2D chemistry
supported_representation_layers.detail: Atom/bond connectivity, bond order, hetero atoms, charges, rings and functional-group annotations.

supported_representation_layers.label: 3D conformer
supported_representation_layers.detail: Rotatable projected conformer with atom inspection and optional hydrogen display.

supported_representation_layers.label: 4D ensemble
supported_representation_layers.detail: Conformer-frame dimension; replace with real MD/trajectory coordinates when available.

supported_representation_layers.label: Ions & isotopes
supported_representation_layers.detail: Common adduct m/z values and an approximate isotope envelope.

supported_representation_layers.label: MS/MS evidence
supported_representation_layers.detail: Link structure hypotheses to mass-spectrum evidence and future fragment annotation.

supported_representation_layers.label: Pathway context
supported_representation_layers.detail: Connect a chemical entity to reactions, pathways and cross-omics evidence.

future_import_formats.purpose: coordinate models for metabolites or complexes

metabolites.name: Pyruvate / pyruvic acid
metabolites.description: Central three-carbon metabolite connecting glycolysis to lactate production and mitochondrial oxidation.

metabolites.name: L-Lactate / lactic acid
metabolites.description: Chiral hydroxy acid produced from pyruvate and widely measured in energy-metabolism studies.

metabolites.name: Citrate / citric acid
metabolites.description: Six-carbon TCA-cycle metabolite and the candidate used by the original metabolomics evidence example.

metabolites.name: D-Glucose
metabolites.description: Major cellular carbon and energy source; represented here in a cyclic stereochemical form.
metabolites.stereochemistry: 5 tetrahedral stereocenter(s): atom 3 R, atom 5 R, atom 7 R, atom 9 S, atom 11 S

metabolites.name: L-Glutamine
metabolites.description: Amino acid that contributes carbon and nitrogen to biosynthesis and cancer-cell metabolism.

metabolites.name: ATP
metabolites.description: Adenosine triphosphate, shown to demonstrate a large, charged/ionizable nucleotide-like metabolite.
metabolites.stereochemistry: 6 tetrahedral stereocenter(s): atom 11 R, atom 13 R, atom 16 ?, atom 20 ?, atom 28 S, atom 30 R

metabolites.name: Palmitate / palmitic acid
metabolites.description: C16 saturated fatty acid and a simple example of a long-chain lipid metabolite.

metabolites.name: Oleate / oleic acid
metabolites.description: C18:1 monounsaturated fatty acid illustrating double-bond geometry in lipid structures.

metabolites.name: PC 16:0/18:1 (POPC-like)
metabolites.description: Representative phosphatidylcholine with one saturated and one monounsaturated acyl chain.

metabolites.name: Cholesterol
metabolites.description: Rigid sterol structure illustrating fused rings, stereochemistry and hydrophobic molecular shape.
metabolites.stereochemistry: 8 tetrahedral stereocenter(s): atom 2 R, atom 9 R, atom 12 S, atom 13 R, atom 16 S, atom 17 S, atom 21 R, atom 24 S

metabolites.name: Sphingosine
metabolites.description: Long-chain sphingoid base used to illustrate amphipathic lipid backbones and stereochemistry.
metabolites.stereochemistry: 2 tetrahedral stereocenter(s): atom 16 R, atom 18 S

metabolites.name: N-Acetyl-D-glucosamine
metabolites.description: A glycan building block. Full glycans require explicit linkage/branch information beyond composition alone.
metabolites.stereochemistry: 5 tetrahedral stereocenter(s): atom 5 S, atom 6 S, atom 9 R, atom 12 S, atom 14 S

metabolites.name: Dopamine
metabolites.description: Small aromatic biogenic amine illustrating an aromatic ring, catechol hydroxyls and a primary amine.
